scientific limitations/integrity: Best-of-knowledge originality is restricted to the complete-multipartite dual-set classification and explicit counting enumerators. The published characterizations of outer sets by mutual maximal distance and total sets by simplicial vertices, and the ordinary general-position observation used in the proof, are prior work. The finite exhaustive certificate corroborates but does not replace the proof. No independent audit, formal proof-assistant verification, or expert attestation has been performed; older strong-resolving-graph literature may implicitly contain the outer-number consequence.
title: Complete multipartite dual general-position sets and exact variant enumerators
